Current candidate also reuses the approved painted Farmer carrot in Snowman and family dinner; source hashes bind those edits and quality remains open. Dinner targets remain grouped on the painted table; independent scene gates remain open. Pool sample windows now preserve the complete wrapper and exclude its pixels from the can; normal focused machine checks and bounded still review pass, complete art acceptance remains open. Current follow-up enlarges sparse Teacher pearl groups within exact card widths and moves Racer lap dials beyond the back button. Independent desktop still review accepts only the changed pearl sizing and lap/back-button separation. Full Teacher/Racer scene quality, animation, higher-tier and device acceptance remain open. Current pool source preserves a6 travel/scoop plus corrected atlas sampling. Racer run05 mounting was rejected; run06 closes the floating gap and is retained as a bounded improvement. Seat/contact4.3 and vehicle ownership3.5 remain below target; no whole-career acceptance.
